maya.chen: FYI: Starfold's Search team is splitting into two squads. Both will onboard embeddings + reranker. PM says start of May. Expected steady qps ~300 req/s total, peaks ~800 qps (short windows). They're asking about batch embed jobs and whether Dedicated reserved will be needed. cc @omar.ruiz for capacity/ops.
omar.ruiz: Thanks — can we get expected token/embedding rates and a simple traffic curve? rough numbers help decide Dedicated vs hosted autoscale.
maya.chen: From the PM: ~20k embed units/day initially, likely ramp to ~150k/day in ~8 weeks. Reranker calls are small but latency-sensitive. Start date ~2026-05-04.
tom.beckett: :eyes: Strong expansion signal. If they convert to Dedicated, we should surface reserved pricing options. @priya.singh any enablement thoughts?
priya.singh: I can run a 45-min enablement for both squads next Tue and prep a short playbook (embedding batching, async jobs, monitoring). Will need model/quant recommendations from @omar.ruiz.
omar.ruiz: Quick capacity check: @infra-bot can you snap current EU embeddings dedicated pools?
infra-bot: Pool snapshot: eu-embeddings-dedicated util 58%, spare headroom 42%, avg latency 12ms. eu-generation-dedicated util 64%. Ops note: ~150k embed/day is feasible hosted with optimized batching + async; peaks might benefit from burst config or Reserved capacity.
maya.chen: PM prefers hosted initially but wants a clear migration path to Dedicated and estimated cost delta.
tom.beckett: Action items — 1) maya: traffic curve + prioritized use cases by Fri; 2) omar: model + batching recommendations by Mon; 3) priya: schedule enablement + draft playbook. I'll loop in renewal after we have traffic curve.
maya.chen: Will collect the curve and ask for API-level call breakdown. Adding to expansion tracker: https://redwood-repo.internal/expansions (internal link).
omar.ruiz: For reranking latency, propose quantized v2-rerank + KV cache; recommend 64-token cache window. I can share a sample config if helpful.
priya.singh: I'll include decision checklist in playbook: thresholds for 'switch to Dedicated' (p50 latency > X ms, sustained embeds/day > Y, cost per 1k embeds).
maya.chen: :thumbsup: thanks all — will post updates in this thread after sync with PM.
